texts.title: Number of unsheltered homeless people in England, 2010 to 2014
texts.subtitle:
Estimated number of unsheltered homeless people in England. Figures correspond to 'point-in-time' estimates
obtained by counting 'rough sleepers' in autumn.
texts.source: Source: Rough Sleeping in England in the 2010s - OWID based on UK National Statistics (2018)
